svg.title: CloudBSD Admin — Node VMs Tab (cloudbsd-node-01)
svg.desc: Detail panel · Node VMs tab active · 8 VMs on this host. Pure-VM view (rule #6); containers and jails are sliced into their own node-detail tabs. Live data only. (2026-07-10 rewrite — was violating rule #6 with mixed-type body.)

div.div: Re-allocate VMs across this node opens a backend action of MIME application/vnd.cloudbsd+vm.reallocate. The admin sees a confirmation modal describing which VMs move where, then confirms. No edit affordances inline on the rows.
